notes: Retrospective study of children aged 6-12 years with low myopia (cycloplegic SER -0.50 to -3.00 D) treated at Chengdu Third People's Hospital, Chengdu, China, January 2022 to August 2025; all consecutive eligible patients were enrolled; follow-ups every 6 months, data recorded for 1 year; only baseline and 1-year values are tabulated. The article states no follow-up-completion criterion and does not report children without a 1-year visit.
Groups by myopia-control intervention (single-vision lenses or HAL lenses, not randomised); age subgroups are defined by baseline age (whole years).
Right eyes only (one eye per child); the authors report a left-eye sensitivity analysis without data.
Device: IOLMaster 700 (Carl Zeiss Meditec). Units: millimetres.
Values are mean +/- SD (Results: all results are presented as mean +/- SD unless otherwise specified).
Spherical equivalent refraction at baseline and 1 year is tabulated (Tables 1-3) and not extracted.
